create_gguf_model_instance: create a GGUF model instance from a HuggingFace model with specified quantization backend and output directory
pack_gguf_layer: pack a quantized model layer into GGUF format by block name and clean up weights after packing
save_quantized_as_gguf: save a quantized model as a GGUF file with optional multimodal projector support
review_FTYPE_MAP: review the FTYPE_MAP dictionary that maps quantization type strings like q4_0 to GGUF LlamaFileType enums
summarize_export_gguf: summarize the GGUF export workflow that creates model instances, packs layers, and writes the final GGUF file
